questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: There's a fireworks display tomorrow. Janet is _____ (1 mot) to watch it.
questions.explication: Intention déjà décidée → be going to.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: We're at that table in the corner. _____ (1 mot) you join us?
questions.explication: Invitation → Will you…? (« Would » a été compté faux sur la copie corrigée.)

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: I'm seeing the boss this afternoon. But I must study this report before I _____ (1 mot) her.
questions.explication: Après before / when / if, on utilise le present simple pour parler du futur.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: There will be drinks at the reception, but there will _____ (1 mot) be any food.
questions.explication: Futur négatif : will not (won't) + base ; « any » appelle une phrase négative.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: The European heads of state are _____ (1 mot) meet in Brussels on 3 October.
questions.explication: be to + base = programme officiel, arrangement formel (are to meet).

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: It's a lovely day. _____ (1 mot) we go for a walk?
questions.explication: Suggestion avec I / we → Shall we…?

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: My birthday _____ (1 mot) on a Sunday next year.
questions.explication: Fait fixé par le calendrier → present simple (is / falls).

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: My brother is engaged. He's _____ (1 mot) married in June.
questions.explication: Arrangement futur déjà organisé → present continuous : he's getting married.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: You won't be allowed to go to your seat after the play _____ (1 mot) started.
questions.explication: Après after / when, une action future terminée s'exprime au present perfect : after the play has started.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIII — Put in the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: Martin's got his coat on. I think he's _____ (1 mot) to go out.
questions.explication: Il a déjà son manteau : imminent → be about to (« going » est aussi grammatical).

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: The Maxi-Shop company is going to build a huge new shopping centre on the edge of Millingham, it was announced yesterday. There _____ (1 mot) be at least three hundred shops, including some big department stores.
questions.explication: Prédiction sur le futur → will + base verbale.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: When the project _____ (1 mot) complete, there **will** be hundreds of new jobs for local people.
questions.explication: Après « when », on utilise le present simple pour parler du futur : when the project is complete.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: When the project **is** complete, there _____ (1 mot) be hundreds of new jobs for local people.
questions.explication: Prédiction sur le futur → will + base verbale.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: But not everyone is happy. 'We're _____ (1 mot) to fight this plan,' said a spokesperson for the local Environment Group.
questions.explication: Intention déjà décidée → be going to.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: 'Just think what is going _____ (1 mot) happen to our countryside.
questions.explication: be going to + base verbale.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: When shopping malls _____ (1 mot) covered the whole country, there **will** be no green fields left.
questions.explication: Après « when » + action terminée avant l'autre → present perfect : when malls have covered…

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: When shopping malls **have** covered the whole country, there _____ (1 mot) be no green fields left.
questions.explication: Prédiction sur le futur → will + base verbale.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: So we're _____ (1 mot) a protest meeting tomorrow evening at the town hall. It **starts** at half past seven.'
questions.explication: Arrangement futur déjà organisé (« tomorrow evening ») → present continuous.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: So we're **having** a protest meeting tomorrow evening at the town hall. It _____ (1 mot) at half past seven.'
questions.explication: Programme / horaire → present simple.

questions.consigne: Ex. XIV — Read the news report and write the missing words. Use one word only in each space.
questions.enonce: Owners of shops in the town centre are also unhappy. 'The new centre _____ (1 mot) take our customers away,' said one of them.
questions.explication: Prédiction sur le futur → will + base verbale.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: Could I have a word with you, please?
B: Sorry, I'm in a big hurry. My train _____ in fifteen minutes.
questions.explication: Horaire de transport → present simple.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: Have you decided about the course?
B: Yes, I decided last weekend. _____ for a place.
questions.explication: Décision déjà prise avant de parler (« I decided last weekend ») → be going to.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: I'm trying to move this cupboard, but it's very heavy.
B: Well, _____ you, then.
questions.explication: Offre spontanée, décidée sur le moment → will.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: Is the shop open yet?
B: No, but there's someone inside. I think _____.
questions.explication: Quelqu'un est déjà à l'intérieur : événement imminent → be about to.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: Do you mind not leaving your papers all over the table?
B: Oh, sorry. I'll take them all with me when _____.
questions.explication: Après « when », on utilise le present simple pour parler du futur.

questions.consigne: Ex. XV — Look at the answers below and write the correct answer in each space.
questions.enonce:
A: It's a public holiday next Monday.
B: Yes, I know. _____ anything special?
questions.explication: On demande ce qui est prévu / organisé → present continuous (arrangement futur).
